proposed_construct: Selective nonsteroidal mineralocorticoid receptor antagonism blocking aldosterone- and cortisol-mediated gene transcription and sodium reabsorption
proposed_objective: Connect selective mineralocorticoid receptor antagonism with reduced MR-mediated sodium reabsorption while distinguishing it from androgen, progesterone, estrogen, and glucocorticoid receptor effects.

proposed_construct: Allosteric inhibition of TYK2 through binding the regulatory domain and stabilizing inhibitory interaction with the catalytic domain
proposed_objective: Differentiate regulatory-domain allosteric TYK2 inhibition from catalytic-site inhibition of other JAK-family kinases.

proposed_construct: Transthyretin tetramer stabilization by binding thyroxine sites and slowing tetramer dissociation, the rate-limiting step in amyloidogenesis
proposed_objective: Link TTR tetramer stabilization to reduced monomer formation and amyloidogenesis.

proposed_construct: Complement C5a receptor antagonism blocking C5a-mediated neutrophil activation and migration
proposed_objective: Distinguish C5a receptor blockade from upstream complement-protein inhibition and terminal membrane-attack-complex blockade.

proposed_construct: CXCR4 antagonism blocking CXCL12-mediated leukocyte retention in bone marrow and promoting peripheral mobilization
proposed_objective: Connect CXCR4-CXCL12 signaling with bone-marrow leukocyte retention and explain pharmacologic mobilization by CXCR4 antagonism.

proposed_construct: Factor B binding with proximal inhibition of the alternative complement pathway, reducing C3 cleavage and downstream terminal complement amplification
proposed_objective: Recognize factor B as a proximal alternative-complement target distinct from C3 and C5 blockade.

proposed_construct: Activation of the Nrf2 pathway involved in cellular responses to oxidative stress
proposed_objective: Recognize Nrf2-pathway activation as the established pharmacodynamic action without overclaiming the disease-level therapeutic mechanism.

proposed_construct: HIF-2 alpha inhibition by blocking HIF-2alpha interaction with HIF-1beta and reducing hypoxia-responsive transcription
proposed_objective: Connect VHL loss with HIF-2alpha stabilization and identify pharmacologic disruption of the HIF-2alpha-HIF-1beta transcriptional complex.
